title: How Does ChatGPT Turn Your Question Into an Answer?
subject: ChatGPT
description:
What actually happens between the moment you send a question to an AI chatbot and the moment its answer appears?
We follow your words in 3D: cut into tokens, turned into lists of numbers, pushed through dozens of layers, multiplied on the maths units of a data-centre chip, and turned into one next word, again and again.
With the real parameter count of GPT-3, from OpenAI's paper.

Chapters:
0:00 Your question leaves your phone
0:14 The whole trip
0:41 Cutting words into tokens
1:40 Tokens become numbers
2:25 Through the layers
3:22 The chip does the maths
4:33 Picking the next token
5:32 Why it can be wrong
5:46 What it can see at once
6:29 Back to your phone

Sources: Brown et al. (arXiv, May 2020); OpenAI Help Center (Nov 2026).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
